tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the Green Venture Tanzania recycled-plastic product catalogue (decking, furniture, fencing, lumber) with TZS prices and units. Optionally filter by category.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. Decking, Furniture, Fencing, Lumber.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one Green Venture Tanzania product by its slug, including full description, TZS price and unit.

tools.name: list_donation_tiers
tools.title: List donation tiers
tools.description: List the Green Venture Tanzania school-desk donation tiers with their TZS amounts and descriptions.

tools.name: estimate_boards_needed
tools.title: Estimate boards needed
tools.description: Estimate how many 3 m recycled-plastic boards are needed to cover an area, from the area in square metres (or width x length) and the board width, plus an allowance for gaps and waste.

areaSqm.description: Area to cover in square metres.

widthM.description: Space width in metres (used with lengthM).

lengthM.description: Space length in metres (used with widthM).

boardWidthMm.description: Board width in millimetres. Defaults to 152.4 mm (6 inch).

gapMm.description: Gap between boards in millimetres. Defaults to 5.
